description: This file defines an abstract class 'DocumentObjectCollection' which serves as a base class for all collection types within the PDFsharp Charting library. It manages a list of DocumentObject items, provides methods for cloning, copying, adding, inserting, removing, and accessing elements, and implements IList for collection behavior.

classes.name: DocumentObjectCollection
classes.description: An abstract collection class for managing DocumentObject items, supporting deep copy, enumeration, and collection manipulation.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the collection.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the collection, including cloning each contained DocumentObject.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the collection elements to an array starting at a specified index.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the collection.

methods.name: InsertObject
methods.description: Inserts a DocumentObject at a specified index.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of a specified DocumentObject.

methods.name: RemoveObjectAt
methods.description: Removes the element at a specified index.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a DocumentObject to the collection, setting its parent.
